items.title: Simplifying Weak Reference Processing in ZGC
items.author: Inside Java
items.summary: What are GC barriers and how do they relate to ahead-of-time compilation? This blog post explores the intersection of HotSpot's GCs and compilers through the lense of implementing GC-agnostic load barriers at the assembly level, and gives key insights on performance and overall takeaways.
